title: Deliver hygiene removes stale untracked copies of records the branch shipped
body:
Outcome: deliver hygiene removes a main-checkout untracked task record that the merged branch committed and later changed (e.g. the open version before the close commit), instead of exiting 77. PR #214: lane B copied untracked tasks/t-zaxbnqj.json from main into its worktree; the merge brought the closed version, main still held the open one, hygiene stopped 'untracked working tree files would be overwritten by merge'. Proof: observer with a main untracked file equal to an earlier branch blob of the same path, red at base.
Lead trap: when shipping an untracked task record from the main checkout, move it (copy into the worktree, then delete the main copy) before the close commit; after an exit 77 on such a file, delete it and rerun deliver from the main checkout.
